svg.title: Sergeant: Plunderspell bestiary concept sheet

text.tspan: Leads the sweep and carries the horn that escalates the raid to the
Hue and Cry, the most consequential prop in the bestiary.
Visibly the senior man: coat-of-plates over mail, with steel pauldrons
Flat-topped great helm with a horizontal vision slit over a mail
Flanged mace: blunt, practical, with no opinion about armour or doors.
The horn on its baldric is bone-white and drawn at weapon weight: a raid
Madder: Tabard. The only household member allowed it, because he's the one

svg.text: Hand-authored SVG · Tools/bestiary_concept_svg.py · concept thumbnail for paint-over, not final art
